briefdescription.para: MO_LO16 - On a symbol operand, this represents a relocation containing lower 16 bit of the address.
MO_HI16 - On a symbol operand, this represents a relocation containing higher 16 bit of the address.
MO_OPTION_MASK - Most flags are mutually exclusive; this mask selects just that part of the flag set.
MO_COFFSTUB - On a symbol operand "FOO", this indicates that the reference is actually to the ".refptr.FOO" symbol.

detaileddescription.para: This is used for stub symbols on windows.

briefdescription.para: MO_GOT - On a symbol operand, this represents a GOT relative relocation.
MO_SBREL - On a symbol operand, this represents a static base relative relocation.

detaileddescription.para: Used in movw and movt instructions.

briefdescription.para: MO_DLLIMPORT - On a symbol operand, this represents that the reference to the symbol is for an import stub.

detaileddescription.para: This is used for DLL import storage class indication on Windows.

briefdescription.para: MO_SECREL - On a symbol operand this indicates that the immediate is the offset from beginning of section.

detaileddescription.para: This is the TLS offset for the COFF/Windows TLS mechanism.

briefdescription.para: MO_NONLAZY - This is an independent flag, on a symbol operand "FOO" it represents a symbol which, if indirect, will get special Darwin mangling as a non-lazy-ptr indirect symbol (i.e.

detaileddescription.para: "L_FOO$non_lazy_ptr"). Can be combined with MO_LO16, MO_HI16 or MO_NO_FLAG (in a constant-pool, for example).

briefdescription.para: MO_LO_0_7 - On a symbol operand, this represents a relocation containing bits 0 through 7 of the address.

detaileddescription.para: Used only with Thumb1 MOV and ADD

briefdescription.para: MO_LO_8_15 - On a symbol operand, this represents a relocation containing bits 8 through 15 of the address.

detaileddescription.para: Used only with Thumb1 MOV and ADD

briefdescription.para: MO_HI_0_7 - On a symbol operand, this represents a relocation containing bits 16 through 23 of the address.

detaileddescription.para: Used only with Thumb1 MOV and ADD

briefdescription.para: MO_HI_8_15 - On a symbol operand, this represents a relocation containing bits 24 through 31 of the address.

detaileddescription.para: Used only with Thumb1 MOV and ADD

briefdescription.para: ARMII - This namespace holds all of the target specific flags that instruction info tracks.
